summary: Software Engineer with 1.5+ years of experience building full-stack web apps, REST APIs, and microservices for multi-tenant SaaS platforms used by millions — currently at Keka HR, previously at Darwinbox.
detailedSummary:
I'm a Software Engineer with 1.5+ years of experience building full-stack web applications, REST APIs, and microservices for multi-tenant SaaS platforms used by millions of people. I currently work at Keka HR, building features across an Angular frontend and .NET backend for an HRMS product used by 4,000+ client organizations, and previously spent over a year at Darwinbox building fault-tolerant backend services and AI-powered HR tooling for a platform serving 3M+ users.

I'm comfortable across the stack — C#/.NET, Node.js, Angular, React, TypeScript, and SQL/NoSQL databases — with hands-on experience in microservices, event-driven systems (Kafka), CI/CD, automated testing, and production on-call support. I've also built LLM- and RAG-powered pipelines that turn unstructured documents into structured, actionable data.

I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from VNR Vignana Jyothi Institute of Engineering & Technology, where I graduated as a Gold Medalist. I enjoy solving hard engineering problems and shipping production-grade software — and I'm always exploring how AI tooling, including the chat assistant on this page, can make software (and portfolios) more useful.
